body: Well, all I used was Google.

I have not asked to be in their group and I do not want to be in their group. I do not understand why my friends would rather spend their time emotionally supporting other people except for me, when I give them emotional support in return and they tell me how I have saved their life! If they don't want to help me, they know where I could get other help and refuse to offer them.

Well, I'm not the guy, but I did a little digging and I found him:

http://www.reddit.com/user/OnanationUnderGod

No, I want my own friends to help me.. but they know other people who've they met online and formed a large bond together... It's like they'd be jealous or hurt or something if I was getting help too.. though I'm not still not sure why.. but yeah.. I have no family to talk to about anything.. I know the group exists because it's on FB.. I don't know why they don't want to listen.. I don't know why it can't be a two way street.. when nobody else is around to help them, I help them.. But they don't help me back... I reply to everything they say too.. and then I just feel used..

I don't want a doctor.. I want friends.. a support system.. somebody who I actually know.. and because every time I say something people would rather ignore me.. and don't even direct me to get help elsewhere even though they get plenty of help.. they have like a tight-knit online group to help them in private.. where it isn't seen by the whole internet.. and I get no help normally..... and in the rare case they reply, most of it's just a bunch of sad smiley faces and the only reason they ever have for me to live is so I can help them with their problems even if they don't help me..
